cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Manager,

I am excited to apply for the E-commerce Operations Specialist position at your international retail group. Your focus on operational excellence, customer experience, and digital transformation resonates with my background in digital operations and web management.

In my current role as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I oversee on-page SEO, content publishing, and WordPress site builds for client websites. This involves daily monitoring of site performance, resolving technical issues, and coordinating with team members to ensure smooth digital journeys. My personal project, mirook.com, required me to design and build a multi-page WordPress site, implement structured data, and conduct iterative technical audits—skills directly applicable to monitoring e-commerce platforms and improving operational KPIs.

Previously, I worked in warehouse and logistics at Katoen Natie, where I gained firsthand experience in high-volume order and delivery processes. This role taught me the importance of accuracy, efficiency, and cross-team coordination in a fast-paced environment. I also have a technical foundation from my front-end development experience at ViviDoctor, which helps me communicate effectively with IT teams.

I am analytical, structured, and solution-oriented. I enjoy diving into details to identify root causes and prioritise actions based on customer impact. I am comfortable working cross-functionally and have a genuine interest in retail and e-commerce. Fluent in English and Turkish, with Dutch at B1 level and improving, I am eager to further develop my Dutch in a professional setting.

I am confident that my proactive, hands-on approach and my ability to bridge e-commerce, IT, and logistics teams would make me a valuable asset. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how I can contribute to your continued growth.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
